news.title: Mayor's State of the Municipality Address on November 26
news.summary: Mayor Nicon F. Fameronag delivers SOMA 2026 on Thursday, November 26, at the Municipal Public Plaza. The program starts at 3:00 PM and the address at 4:00 PM, followed by the Christmas lighting, fireworks and a concert at the plaza.
news.title_fil: State of the Municipality Address ng Mayor sa Nobyembre 26
news.summary_fil: Ihahatid ni Mayor Nicon F. Fameronag ang SOMA 2026 sa Huwebes, Nobyembre 26, sa Municipal Public Plaza. Magsisimula ang programa ng 3:00 PM at ang talumpati ng 4:00 PM, kasunod ang Christmas lighting, fireworks at konsiyerto sa plaza.

news.title: Pista sa Sibale 2026 runs from November 21 to December 8
news.summary: The town fiesta opens with volleyball and basketball tournaments on November 21 and ends on December 8, the feast of the Immaculate Conception, with the Rungawan Festival, the Kami Ray Barangay Festival and the coronation night. The Bangkarera boat race and Mutya ng Sibale are on December 4.
news.title_fil: Pista sa Sibale 2026 mula Nobyembre 21 hanggang Disyembre 8
news.summary_fil: Magbubukas ang pista ng bayan sa mga torneo ng volleyball at basketball sa Nobyembre 21 at magtatapos sa Disyembre 8, kapistahan ng Inmaculada Concepcion, kasama ang Rungawan Festival, Kami Ray Barangay Festival at coronation night. Ang Bangkarera at Mutya ng Sibale ay sa Disyembre 4.

news.title: Free tooth extraction at the Rural Health Unit, November 16–20
news.summary: A provincial government dental mission offered free tooth extraction at the Concepcion Rural Health Unit in Poblacion from November 16 to 20. Patients registered at the RHU.
news.title_fil: Libreng bunot ng ngipin sa Rural Health Unit, Nobyembre 16–20
news.summary_fil: Nagkaroon ng libreng bunot ng ngipin mula sa pamahalaang panlalawigan sa Concepcion Rural Health Unit sa Poblacion mula Nobyembre 16 hanggang 20. Nagpalista ang mga pasyente sa RHU.

news.title: Three families relocated from high-risk areas receive new homes
news.summary: Under the municipality's Pabahay Project, three families from coastal and watershed areas at high risk of disasters received certificates of award for new disaster-resilient housing units, from Calabasahan, San Pedro and Poblacion.
news.title_fil: Tatlong pamilyang inilipat mula sa mapanganib na lugar, may bagong bahay na
news.summary_fil: Sa ilalim ng Pabahay Project ng munisipyo, tumanggap ng certificate of award para sa bagong bahay na matibay laban sa sakuna ang tatlong pamilya mula sa baybayin at watershed na mataas ang panganib, mula Calabasahan, San Pedro at Poblacion.

news.title: Steel-hulled RoPax ferry for Sibale proposed
news.summary: The mayor met ferry operators' and investment groups (PACIWF, ACLUNAGA, the Board of Investments and PTIC Madrid) about a proposed modern steel-hulled roll-on/roll-off passenger ferry serving Concepcion. It is a proposal; no service date has been announced.
news.title_fil: Iminumungkahing RoRo na barkong bakal para sa Sibale
news.summary_fil: Nakipagpulong ang mayor sa mga ferry operator at investment group (PACIWF, ACLUNAGA, Board of Investments at PTIC Madrid) tungkol sa isang modernong RoRo na barkong bakal para sa Concepcion. Panukala pa lamang ito; wala pang petsa ng serbisyo.

news.title: National ID registration held in every barangay
news.summary: PSA registration and paper National ID issuance moved barangay by barangay from August 17 (Poblacion) into September, including children from age 0. Ask your barangay hall about any catch-up schedule.
news.title_fil: National ID registration sa bawat barangay
news.summary_fil: Lumipat ang PSA registration at pag-iisyu ng paper National ID mula barangay sa barangay simula Agosto 17 (Poblacion) hanggang Setyembre, kasama ang mga batang 0 taong gulang pataas. Magtanong sa inyong barangay hall tungkol sa susunod na iskedyul.

news.title: Rural Health Unit passes PhilHealth YAKAP inspection with no findings
news.summary: PhilHealth YAKAP inspectors reported that the Concepcion Rural Health Unit passed its inspection without any findings.
news.title_fil: Pumasa ang Rural Health Unit sa PhilHealth YAKAP inspection nang walang findings
news.summary_fil: Iniulat ng mga inspektor ng PhilHealth YAKAP na pumasa ang Concepcion Rural Health Unit sa inspeksyon nang walang anumang findings.

news.title: Tree planting at the Gaylang watershed for Arbor Day
news.summary: Municipal employees, government agencies and Calabasahan barangay officials planted trees at Gaylang, Barangay Calabasahan, where the Small Water Impounding Project (SWIP) supplies the new water system.
news.title_fil: Pagtatanim ng puno sa Gaylang watershed para sa Arbor Day
news.summary_fil: Nagtanim ng puno ang mga kawani ng munisipyo, mga ahensya ng pamahalaan at mga opisyal ng Barangay Calabasahan sa Gaylang, kung saan nagsusuplay ng tubig ang Small Water Impounding Project (SWIP) sa bagong water system.
